title: HexTiles
description: Adds new hexagonal tiles, for floors or for walls.
body:
This mod adds a new block type, the hexagonal tile!
Crafted with six slabs of any wood type, the haxagonal tiles can be placed down on the ground and fit together in their own hexagonal grid.


Curently all of the tiles are:
| Tiles (place on the ground)             | Plaques (placed on walls)               |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|
| Oak                 | Gold                  |
| Spruce              | Iron                  |
| Birch               | Copper                |
| Jungle              | Emerald               |
| Mangrove            | Diamond               |
| Acacia              | Netherite             |
Dark Oak
Cherry
Bamboo
Crimson
Warped
